caption: The drawing features three distinct metal objects rendered in shades of gray against an off-white background. At the top is a rectangular backplate with rounded corners and four screw holes, each near a corner. Mounted on this plate is a rounded knob at the center top, below which a flat, rectangular lever extends downward, paired with a smaller vertical cylindrical bar on the left side and a thin diagonal rod on the right. A horizontal bar crosses these elements at mid-height, completing what appears to be a latching mechanism. Below this main structure are two simpler objects: the first is a horizontal rectangular plate with a hole at each end and a circular knob protruding from its left half. The lowest object is a long, slender horizontal bar with a downward-pointing triangular piece attached near its center. All objects are shaded to indicate metallic texture and their shapes, with clear lines and some shadows to suggest three-dimensionality.
title: Combination Latch/Lock
